tool: Outgoing webhooks with signature verification
checked: Registered a webhook for five events with a known secret, then triggered matter.created (POST /matters/new) and task.completed (POST /tasks/<id>/done) through the real UI with requests.post captured. Both fired exactly once, to the registered URL, carrying X-Coil-Event, X-Coil-Delivery (the WebhookDelivery id) and X-Coil-Signature. I recomputed hmac.new(secret, raw_body, sha256) myself and both signatures matched exactly; the body is the sorted-key JSON envelope {event, created_at, data}. Deliveries were stored with status ok / attempts 1 / response_code 200. I then made the transport return HTTP 500: the delivery was recorded status=failed, attempts=1, response_code=500, last_error='HTTP 500'. `python -m app.cli webhooks` correctly declined to retry inside the 1-minute backoff (0 retried), and after aging last_at by 10 minutes it retried once and reported '1 retried, 1 delivered, 0 still failing', leaving the row ok at attempts=2. Events are queued on the session and only flushed after_commit, with an after_rollback handler that drops them, so a rolled-back change cannot fire a webhook.
notes: Delivery uses its own short-lived Session so it never joins the caller's transaction; MAX_ATTEMPTS 5 with 1/5/30/120/720-minute backoff.

tool: Voice line endpoints (app/blueprints/voice.py)
checked: With Firm.voice_enabled off, all seven endpoints (config, lookup, verify, pin, note, time, calls) return 403 {ok:false, reason:'voice_disabled'} with the settings pointer, and an unauthenticated call is 401 before that. With voice on: /config returns the firm identity, greeting name, practice areas, approved lines, callback tiers and all 8 endpoint descriptions. /lookup returns only {found: true|false} and never a name, matter or balance, for both a known and an unknown number, and always sets verification_required. /verify refuses with client_status_off when Firm.voice_client_status is off; with it on, a wrong name against a known number returns name_mismatch and an unknown number returns no_match, both with 'offer a callback' and no client data; the right name returned the contact and 3 open matters with stage, balance, next event, next task and a last_update line that says WHAT changed ('a note was added by ...') and never the note body. PIN: five wrong PINs counted down attempts_left 4,3,2,1,0 and the sixth returned 423 locked, after which even the CORRECT PIN is refused with 423 - the lock holds. A good PIN opened a 30-minute session keyed to the call_id. /note and /time both return 403 pin_required without a verified PIN and created nothing in the DB; with a verified PIN the note was stored as '[by phone] ...' under the right user and matter, and 25 minutes became a 30-minute TimeEntry at the matter rate. A note posted with a different call_id was refused (sessions do not leak between calls) and a mismatched user_id on a verified call returned user_mismatch. Matter hints: no match 404, ambiguous 409 with the candidate list, zero minutes and empty description both 400. /calls stored kind, from, to, duration, outcome and a flattened transcript and shows on /voice and /voice/<id>. A read-scope token is refused on every write endpoint.
notes: Twilio itself was mocked; the actual outbound call is the only part needing a live third party, and place_call degrades to a [VOICE-DEV] log line when Twilio is unset. Note that /voice (the call log with transcripts) is not in permissions.PREFIX_PERMS, so every role including readonly and paralegal can read it - see the permissions finding above.
